stem: Xavier would like to replace sentence 2 with a sentence that will improve the focus of his paper. Which sentence should he use?

options.label: A
options.text: LEGO bricks are a great toy because building with them teaches children important skills.

options.label: B
options.text: Playing with LEGO bricks is a hobby families can really enjoy together.

options.label: C
options.text: I was surprised that I had never heard of the LEGO KidsFest.

options.label: D
options.text: Last week I had a great day with my family and learned about one of my favorite toys at LEGO KidsFest.
